Preserve queues/retries/mail encoding/auth/subscriber permissions/hook ordering and subprocess behavior; adapt fake SMTP/email tools into owned-fixture tests before execution.

Map every CLI/web route and option to embedded-server/API equivalents, including CGI/SCGI/extension deployment compatibility decisions, resource limits and child lifecycle; server substitution cannot delete xfer/security/extension mechanisms.
Define intentional rendering differences and replacement assertions against chosen Gest Markdown engine; retain source examples, security/link/HTML behavior and observed th1-markdown-5 failure.

Specify interpreter/FFI lifecycle, Tcl8.6/9/stubs, taint/escaping/permissions, docs/hooks and error parity. Disabled reference features remain required configurations, not exclusions.
Preserve Unicode/case/glob/regexp/SQL matching and search-index consistency; add differential malformed and boundary tests, full-text query/result/permission tests.
Separate underlying graph/report/feed/caching algorithms from substituted presentation; map ordering/filter/permission/invalidation/SQL-report and graph fixtures to contract tests.
Map each upstream page/action to chosen Gest UI/API flow and required engine operation, including edit conflicts, permissions, docs paths and customization; reduced UI is not an engine exemption.

Specify signing/verification, Git/SVN/import/export/mirror data parity, external command quoting/errors, multi-repository isolation and terminal formatting; add owned-process fixtures across platforms.
Qualify FUSE-enabled reference and Rust behavior, mount/unmount/path/permission/history reads, platform availability and interruption; disabled build is not removed scope.

Resolve supported Windows contract and equivalent platform behavior before full port acceptance; run Windows native service/HTTP fixtures if required. Keep source accounted even though current host is macOS.
Enumerate FUZZ_* dispatch choices from source, retain seed corpus, qualify Linux sanitizer/libFuzzer and Rust fuzz equivalents; no fuzz campaign executed in this inventory.
Compare embedded resource names/bytes/cache behavior and generated-resource reproducibility; retain source assets and licenses.

Build reference with JSON enabled; enumerate every JSON subcommand and envelope/error/auth contract, map to preserved public endpoint or explicit requirement-based replacement assertion. Current JSON suite skipped.
Preserve local changes and all conflict/update outputs; retain observed update-message-add-overwrites failure, add crash/undo and cross-checkout state fixtures.
Explicitly map storage retention, cursor/poll delivery, attachment/download and permission/privacy semantics; transient chat is still required engine scope.
Choose compatible Pikchr execution strategy and test rendering/errors/resource limits/embedded integration. Gest Markdown replacement alone does not replace diagrams.
Map build options/generated resources/platform targets to reproducible Rust/reference configurations; do not treat build documentation as implemented gates.
Extract behavioral claims/examples from each retained page and map to tests; file inventory is not a page-by-page behavioral audit.
Decide equivalent Gest interaction/visual/accessibility/asset/license mapping; retain related engine workflow contracts and add visual/workflow tests.
Resolve licenses, features/ABI/compile flags and differential dependency behavior; libsql replaces SQLite family, while Tcl/diagram/compression mechanisms remain required.
Determine standalone CVS-tool support and preserved import result semantics; create fixture repositories for every conversion stage/cycle/symbol edge before any rewrite.
Retain exact fixtures and classify runnable/manual/dormant/build/platform prerequisites; convert manual observations into assertions under owned resources before reporting passes.

completion_boundary.complete: Every tracked file has exact identity/hash, role, normative disposition, proposed responsibility, rationale and linked test/contract relation or missing-test follow-up; every declared/native diagnostic hook maps to pinned source.

recommendation: Review open contract questions and normative dispositions independently, then close remaining phase1 acceptance prerequisites. Advance engine phase2 only after the director records the phase1 decision.
